description: This PHP class 'StackedColumn' represents a visual or structural element used within the reporting system of OrangeHRM, specifically for handling stacked column headers with nested columns. It provides methods for managing child columns, setting a name, and converting the structure to an array for further processing or rendering.

classes.name: StackedColumn
classes.description: A class representing a stacked column header which can contain multiple child columns and be labeled with an optional name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stacked column with an array of child columns.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the stacked column, or null if not set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Retrieves the array of child columns.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets multiple child columns, replacing existing ones, and adds them via addChild.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a single Column object as a child to the stacked column.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the stacked column and its children into an array structure for serialization or rendering.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of child columns (via the Countable interface).
